messages:
harper: found a KMS-wrapped ciphertext inside a partner onboarding artifact stored in s3://partner-intake/2026-03-22/onboard_bundle.tar.gz (file: secrets/wrapped_auth.blob). not opening locally; copying to quarantine and looping sec.

noah: thanks. header hint (redacted) and which KMS key is referenced? also list who can read that prefix so we can map blast radius.

harper: header (redacted): `gcp_kms_v1|projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/onboard-kr/cryptoKeys/onboard-wrapping|v1` — looks like our CMK. ACLs: group:partner-uploads (write), role:build-bots (read), svcacct:redwood-onboard@infra (read).

mina: auto-created INC-2026-121. severity P2 (suspected credential exposure). checklist: quarantine, export storage access logs for 45d, query KMS Decrypt audit, and prepare RBAC scoped deny.

devex-bot: [AUTO] detection=0.83 rule=kms_wrapped_blob_in_artifact recommended=quarantine_and_rekey incident=INC-2026-121

harper: quarantine copy: `aws s3 cp s3://partner-intake/2026-03-22/onboard_bundle.tar.gz s3://sec-quarantine/6345678901-onboard_bundle.tar.gz` (stored unopened in secure project). checksum sha256=bd9a72f3... saved to ticket.

noah: I'll pull CloudTrail logs for Decrypt on that key: `aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/cloudtrail --filter-pattern 'Decrypt AND onboard-wrapping' --start-time -2592000000` and GCS access logs for partner mirrors. will attach to the incident.

mina: RBAC mitigation plan: apply a scoped deny for s3:GetObject on prefix `partner-intake/2026-03-22/*` to member `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/partner-uploads` with TTL 4 hours. schedule at 02:00 PT to reduce impact. posting policy in INC-2026-121.

luis: question: do we rotate our CMK or ask partner to rotate inner credentials? if it's our key used to wrap, we must create a new key version and disable decrypt on the old one while we forensically examine. partner still must rotate any inner tokens.

noah: logs show a Decrypt call 6 days ago by `serviceAccount:partner-ci@partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and one Decrypt 2 days ago by `svc:redwood-onboard@infra`. no external IPs. blast radius limited to partner CI and our onboard svcacct.

harper: given that, plan: (1) create new key version for onboard-wrapping, (2) remove decrypt binding from non-infra principals on old key version, (3) rewrap quarantined blobs in secure project with new key, (4) ask partner to rotate any inner credentials referenced. I'll coordinate the quarantine rewrap.

mina: good. please coordinate with SRE about impact of removing decrypt for `redwood-onboard@infra` temporarily; we may break live onboarding jobs. propose rolling window 01:00-03:00 PT.

luis: drafting partner notification: "We discovered a KMS-wrapped blob referencing a Redwood-managed KMS key inside an onboarding bundle we mirrored. We have quarantined the artifact and are rotating access to the wrapping key. Please rotate any secrets contained in your artifact and confirm to partner-ops. Reference: INC-2026-121." send once RBAC applied.

devex-bot: [AUTO] checklist appended to INC-2026-121: export-logs, quarantine-copy, create-key-version, revoke-old-decrypt, rewrap-sweep, partner-notify, postmortem

noah: rewrap notes: run in secure CI under locked service account. pseudo: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=onboard-wrapping --keyring=onboard-kr && secure-run decrypt-old --input gs://sec-quarantine/6345678901-onboard_bundle.tar.gz | secure-run encrypt-new --kms=projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/onboard-kr/cryptoKeys/onboard-wrapping/v2 > gs://sec-quarantine/rewrapped/6345678901.tar.gz` (all in secure project; no plaintext persisted outside memory). I'll make the script and KMS permission list.

harper: assigned tasks in ticket: harper -> quarantine + checksum + partner comms draft; noah -> audit logs + rewrap script; mina -> RBAC patch + incident lead; luis -> postmortem owner. Target: RBAC applied within 4h, key-version created in secure project within 6h, rewrap sweep within 24h, postmortem within 72h.

mina: posting RBAC patch now. will loop SRE and devex to confirm scheduling.

harper: thanks. updating INC-2026-121 with artifacts and timeline. will follow up when rewrap completes. :thumbsup:
